newsitem.title: POLAND: MostostalW sees 1997 net up to PLN 6 mln.
newsitem.headline: MostostalW sees 1997 net up to PLN 6 mln.

text.p: Polish construction company Mostostal Warszawa SA forecasts its net profit will rise to six million zlotys in 1997 from 4.4 million zlotys last year, the firm said in a statement on Tuesday.
It said it forecast its 1997 sales to increase to 170 million zlotys from last year's 114.4 million zlotys.

The statement said Mostostal's group forecast 1997 net profit was 7.2 million zlotys, up from 5.1 million zlotys last year. Sales are forecast at 230 million zlotys, compared with 144.4 million zlotys in 1996.
